C1.tr: I was half asleep when I went home.

C1.tr: Snow reminds me of my hometown.

C1.tr: As a rule, twins have a lot in common.

C1.tr: I'm sorry I have no pencil to write with.

C1.tr: I don't like the taste of tomatoes.

C1.tr: Somebody farted in the elevator.

C1.tr: Do you write with a blue or a black pen?

C1.tr: My aunt goes to bingo every Sunday.
